title: Decision UIs
description: Dedicated layouts for decisions that used to be a plain list of options. Synthetic gallery fixtures, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Unexpected Action: recall your token
shots.caption: Each system holding one of your command tokens is shown with its planets, ships and tokens instead of a bare system number, and can be picked on the map.

shots.heading: Predictive Intelligence: restack tokens
shots.caption: The end-of-turn redistribution as pools to arrange, with tokens moved out and in marked. Confirm says how many moves it will send (here 2); the engine takes them one per question, then the plan finishes with 'done'. 647 of these questions were answered as plain lists in the nightly runs.
